prior_outcomes_seen: PR263 already showed 0/24 daily, 10/24 known-change-point split seven-day and 24/24 HOLD when seven-day pooled source crossed a known step at high budget. This follow-up is exploratory relative to that public source-free result.
scientific_question: A maintenance log restricts a detector q change to original within-branch pair index j∈{18,19,20,21,22,23}; can fixed-trained clock/solar/season model rankings be certified without pretending one date is known?

external_maintenance_evidence.no_step_world: negative control generator; external log may record ambiguous maintenance but does NOT attest q unchanged, so point guess still nonadmissible

equal_cost_reference_methods.q_source: independently select reference date uniformly j<20 vs j>=20 for each trial, count Binomial at group MEAN q; source is valid but daily TARGET q not attested over the external interval, so HOLD in all step and no-step worlds

independent reference true-passages ONLY from guaranteed-pre j0..17 or guaranteed-post j23..40, with 20*n source trials per pre group and 21*n per post group, budget conserved. Each uncertain date j18..22 gets union of pre/post simultaneous CP intervals: [min(Lpre,Lpost),max(Upre,Upost)]. Valid if detector q is piecewise constant with at most one step in independent candidate set.

simulator ONLY: knows actual step j18/20/23 (or no step), partitions original dates into pre/post by true step and draws independent source true-passages uniformly from the correct segment, 20*n and 21*n opportunities allocated to pre/post (not necessarily proportional to segment duration). This is an unrealizable gold-standard comparator for uncertain real maintenance logs; source calibration joint CP applies to each true group.

randomization.original_site_types: reuse PR260 physical_site_q(1) fixed 32 IID sites
randomization.original_no_step_animal: reuse PR263 station-branch-stable event generator for step null
randomization.step20_animal: reuse PR263 step20 animal event generator and frozen RNG exactly
randomization.reference_sampling: For each predeclared source segment, every true passage opportunity independently picks a reference date uniformly from eligible segment days then detects Bernoulli(q_day). Valid iid Binomial(group mean q) even when group crosses step; its mean may be wrong for target dates.
randomization.source_budget: Each source method uses 41*n reference opportunities PER physical heldout station×photoperiod branch×civil4h clock cell, identically 16×2×6×41×n total, allocated 20*n to pre and 21*n to post for both true oracle and uncertainty envelope methods.

inference.cp_source: Exact simultaneous two-sided Clopper–Pearson across 16 sites×2 branches×6 civil4h bins×2 groups =384 q-source cells, each one-sided tail .025/(2*384), source trials 20*n and 21*n.
inference.target_day_q: definite pre or definite post uses respective CP interval; uncertain j18..22 uses envelope union across both independent CP intervals; conditionally guaranteed if independent candidate set contains true step and the single-step q assumption holds.
inference.per_site_pred_score: All 82 original dates and 96 original CIVIL quarterhour bins, 5 fixed training-only model families. Shared same unknown q of one physical site/date original civil bin for candidate A/B. Event-specific q cancels; normalizer ratio optimized with 65-step linear fractional routine over six original civil 4h blocks, per date separately to give conservative OUTER q site logscore.
inference.site_sign: 16 IID physically independent heldout camera sites; K strict-positive q-robust lower scores; nonrandomized Binomial(16,.5) right tail <.00625 => K>=14. No treating dates or recorded detections as independent.
inference.time_scope_if_no_real_external_log: HOLD real-life inference absent verified candidate bounds and station-specific gold true passage calibration; source-free synthetic only.

fail_closed: Original 41 date pairs, original 82 civil calendar dates and SAME 96 clock bins across all models.
All 192×3 source-free comparisons retained regardless of unfavorable outcomes.
Original true step at j18/20/23 and no-step generator; candidate set j18..23 fixed before outputs.
Reference candidate source eligible guaranteed pre indices 0..17 and guaranteed post indices 23..40; all 5 uncertain indices 18..22 may be either side under possible step dates.
Each independently labeled true passage reference date is iid sampled within a source group and camera success Bernoulli(q_true_day).
All methods receive exactly the same total true gold passage opportunity B, allocated 20n+21n to reference groups.
Correct CP familywise 0.025 for 384 source groups, independent of wildlife count response.
Even when point guess happens to equal true step in a synthetic world, external candidate log does NOT certify exact date; point guess method must HOLD, never benefit from synthetic oracle knowledge.
If group-source q CP simultaneously covers true group q, uncertain envelope contains every true date q for any single step in predeclared candidate range.
Never gate an inferential test on oracle knowledge that q intervals covered actual synthetic true q.
Only 16 physical camera sites count toward site-majority trial; 4 preregistered model pairs have alpha=.00625 each.
Datewise sharp q bounds are conservative OUTER for physically shared q segments; no claim overall sharpness or source empirical test of solar zeitgeber.
No original real EcoBank wildlife events, device uptime logs, q reference passage labels, or source maintenance logs inspected; earlier ODSP qualified inferences and previous first ledgers untouched.
